question: If ‘G’, ‘M’ and ‘R’ represent the universal gravitation constant, mass of the earth and radius of the earth, respectively, then which of the following is the correct expression for the acceleration due to gravity (g) on the surface of the earth?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**GM / R²**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The acceleration due to gravity (g) on the surface of the Earth is given by the formula: g = GM / R²</stro
